items.title: Maguire: I want to be greedy about winning trophies

items.title: Celtic out to erase Kairat pain as O'Neill eyes Champions League return
items.description: Twelve months ago, Celtic's humiliating Champions League exit to Kairat Almaty set the tone for a campaign of chaos. Martin O'Neill is determined to erase that pain.
